Analysis is not billed separately; its cost is included in the generation price.

accessToken.description: Scoped OmniMux personal credential. Each operation lists its exact influencer_creation grant. No automatic expansion for old or legacy tokens. Do not use an sk- relay key. Website sessions are validated separately by the existing account authentication.

Selection.description: Map category IDs to ordered option-ID arrays from options.taxonomy. This is an object, not a flat array. Unknown categories/options and incompatible combinations are rejected; tier visibility and existing selection normalization apply.

content_url.description: Short-lived signed artifact URL. Re-read the artifact endpoint if it expires. Never send the account credential to this URL or its storage redirects.

video_metadata.description: Server-observed media facts of a generated video artifact. Omitted for historical tasks and for non-video artifacts. Best-effort: duration comes from the container and video_duration currently mirrors it, so consumers still validate against their own constraints.

video_duration.description: Video-track duration in seconds. Currently mirrors duration because the generated output is not fully decoded.

video_codec.description: Reported video codec, such as h264 or hevc.

audio_codec.description: Reported audio codec; empty when the output has no audio track.

container.description: Container format, such as mp4 or mov.

duration_sec.description: Integer generation duration in seconds derived by the server from the reference video; fractional seconds may be rounded. For recreate it echoes the duration_sec submitted from the analyze result. Not a creation input, the exact reference duration, or a measurement of the finished video.

request_id.description: Client recovery ID; may be empty for earlier website tasks without a CLI receipt. Distinct from HTTP tracing request IDs.

raw_status.description: Native task status; use normalized status for automation.

artifact_status.description: ready requires succeeded plus usable artifacts. An accepted request or empty artifact list is not a delivered result.

recovery_expires_at.description: Unix seconds. Zero while active or before a terminal deadline is established. Recovery lasts seven days after completion; expiry never permits request-ID reuse.

replayed.description: Returned by creation, request recovery and task/artifact detail. Character projections need not include this field.

raw_quota.description: Known native quota record, not credits: raw_quota / 500000 = USD. Omitted if no positive known amount exists.

credits.description: Known raw_quota / 50000. Not an upfront quote or proof of a final refund.

quota_status.description: reconciling on failed tasks does not confirm a completed refund.

fail_reason.description: Public failure reason, when available; inspect with status. Never infer successful refund from a failure message.

fail_reason.description: Public failure reason, when available; inspect with status. Never infer successful refund from a failure message.

multiviews.description: Owned related multiview tasks, including unfinished and failed tasks.

prompt_map.description: Embedded prompt metadata; choose input IDs from categories rather than sending this object.

creation_enabled.description: False disables new CLI creations, not reads or identical accepted replays. True alone does not establish compatible route availability.

min_seconds.description: Minimum accepted reference-video duration in seconds, not the finished-video duration.

max_seconds.description: Maximum accepted reference-video duration in seconds, not a guarantee about the finished-video duration.

preserves_reference_audio.description: Reference audio is supplied to generation; output loudness may change. This does not promise lossless or bit-for-bit audio preservation.

request_id.description: Required, case-sensitive account-scoped recovery key. Repeating the same intent returns the original task; changed content returns 409.

tier.description: normal: ordinary person; freak: stylized person; total: exaggerated person; cats/dogs: anthropomorphic animal.

brief.description: Appearance and wardrobe guidance; the fixed dual-view composition is preserved. For human types provide at least one valid option, a brief, or a style image.

image_url.description: Optional style-reference image. JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 5 MiB. It must be publicly fetchable and passes the existing image safety checks.

mode.description: motion and replace take exactly one reference source. recreate takes a compiled prompt plus reference images and no reference video.

duration_sec.description: recreate only: the whole-second duration reported as meta.duration_sec by the analyze poll. Send exactly that value. The server rejects values outside 4-15 seconds with 400 invalid_request; motion and replace ignore this field and derive the duration from the reference clip. The server validates only the range, so an in-range value other than the analyzed one becomes the output length while the compiled prompt was written for the analyzed one.

character_task_id.description: Successful owned original character. Its image is prepended to image_urls as the primary subject. Multiview outputs cannot be used as this original-character ID.

image_urls.description: Ordered subject/support images. With character_task_id, at most 29 supplemental images. Otherwise at least one image is required, and image_urls[0] is the primary subject. Total: 1-30. For recreate, keep the same order as the analyze request.

video_url.description: Exactly one reference source: this public HTTPS clip or video_task_id. Server inspects actual media; no client duration input.

video_task_id.description: Owned successful character-video task used as the reference clip; exclusive with video_url.

aspect_ratio.description: 480p: 16:9, 9:16, 3:4. 720p: 16:9, 9:16. Motion: explicit value wins, otherwise follow a supported source ratio, otherwise 9:16. Replace: keep the supported source ratio and reject a conflicting explicit value. Recreate is fixed to 9:16 and rejects any other explicit value.

prompt.description: motion/replace: optional compatible performance/scene guidance. recreate: required compiled prompt returned by the analyze poll, up to 4000 runes. Reference audio and primary character identity/species remain part of the motion generation contract.

video_url.description: Public HTTPS reference clip: 4-15 seconds, MP4/MOV, at most 64 MiB. The generated clip follows this length. It is decomposition material only and never reaches a generation model.

image_urls.description: Ordered reference images the caller owns. image_urls[0] is the primary subject; one per-image reading is returned for every entry.

image_tags.description: Optional hints aligned by position with image_urls; at most one tag per image and 20 characters each. They are context for the image reading, never provider parameters.

prompt.description: Optional creative intent: what to keep and what to replace. Planner context only; it is not the final prompt.

resolution.description: Selects the price tier reported in meta.pricing for the later generation. It does not change the decomposition or the derived duration.

kind.description: What the model read the image as, for example product, person or scene.

angle.description: Viewpoint of the image as read by the model.

uncertain.description: What this image could not establish; empty when nothing was uncertain.

risk_flags.description: Deterministic gate codes the compile answer raised, for example identity, brand or on-screen-text risk. Not a legal conclusion.

duration_sec.description: Whole-second output duration derived from the reference clip. Pass exactly this value as duration_sec when generating.

reference_duration_sec.description: Fractional picture duration probed from the reference clip.

480p.description: Exact credits the pre-charge takes for this derived duration at 480p.

720p.description: Exact credits the pre-charge takes for this derived duration at 720p.

pricing.description: Exact credit amount per selectable quality for the derived duration (1 USD = 10 credits). Absent when no live price is available. Use it for the generate button; do not recompute locally.

status.description: Poll until success or failed; running means the job is still in the queue or planner.

prompt.description: Success only. The compiled Seedance prompt; send it as prompt to POST /api/influencer/v1/videos with mode=recreate.

analysis.description: Success only. Structured breakdown with schema_version viral-recreate.analysis/1. Top-level keys: evidence, video_overview, pace, shots, hook, viral_logic, transferable, replace, product_props, cta, uncertain, quality.

image_analysis.description: Success only. One reading per submitted image, in image_urls order.

message.description: Failed only. Public failure reason; the analysis itself is not billed.

NativePaymentRequired.description: 402 is native execution billing semantics, not a synchronous response emitted by current queue acceptance.

example.message: insufficient account allowance
